o_declarations: one local Direct profile has one explicit durable substrate and at most one SQLite writer generation
filesystem bytes, SQLite pages, Unix peer credentials, process lifetimes, and wall-clock observations remain O until owner-issued bridges establish E or D standing
DSS-0.2 persists lawful request custody and delivery state but performs no semantic compilation, evidence materialization, worker execution, result admission, evaluation, or completion
e_observation_bridges: kernel peer credentials become a bounded transport observation but never a semantic principal
an admitted daemon public verifier plus a one-use connection- and generation-bound Ed25519 request proof becomes a durable authorization receipt for one operation and scope
canonical event envelopes plus per-job/global digest chains and HMAC custody tags become authenticated job history
verified publish-before-reference turns canonical bytes into a lawful CAS artifact reference
deterministic reducer replay turns an authenticated event prefix into a derived current-state projection
restart verification turns a complete store observation into an explicit recovery disposition
forbidden_grants: requester labels, Unix identity, capability reference strings, receipts, queue position, or renderer state as authority
CAS existence, SQLite rows, process exit, provider markers, empty results, or client display as semantic completion
mutable projection heads as truth independent of the event history
quarantine bytes in ordinary events, renderer projections, or unprivileged results
silent retry, lease renewal, cancellation success, orphan attachment, corruption repair, or authority substitution on restart
DSS-0.3+ execution, compiler, materializer, worker, MicroResult, attestation, evaluation, or disposition authority
serialized or cloned DSS-0.1 principal/capability projections, caller-supplied verifier records, public keys, signatures, or references as daemon authority
